shortIntro.title: WePlay Party Ready: What Your Phone Needs 🎉📱
shortIntro.para1: WePlay is all about connecting with friends, voice chat, and mini-game fun — without burning out your device 😄. Unlike heavy shooters, WePlay focuses on smooth animations, stable voice quality, and lag-free party rooms.
shortIntro.para2: A capable processor, enough RAM, and a stable internet connection are all you need to enjoy ludo nights, trivia challenges, and chaotic mini-games without hiccups 🎤😂.

intro: Here’s a practical guide to the minimum and recommended specs to enjoy WePlay seamlessly on Android and iOS. All recommendations are tested by casual gamers, party hosts, and night-owl voice chat pros 😎🎧.

minimum.RAM: 2GB (sufficient for basic rooms and voice chat 🙂)
minimum.Internet: Stable Wi-Fi or 4G for clear, uninterrupted voice 🎙️

recommended.RAM: 4GB+ for smooth multitasking and party rooms 🚀
recommended.CPU: Octa-Core Snapdragon / Helio / Dimensity or equivalent
recommended.Storage: 1.5GB+ free space to accommodate updates and effects
recommended.Internet: Fast Wi-Fi or 4G/5G for zero lag and instant room joining 🎉

faqIntroText: WePlay FAQs – quick answers for party pros 🎉:

faqList.question: Is WePlay heavy on phones?
faqList.answer: Nope! WePlay is designed to run even on older or mid-range phones. It’s far lighter than FPS or battle royale games.

faqList.question: Do I need a strong GPU?
faqList.answer: Not really. A decent CPU and stable internet are more important than fancy graphics.

faqList.question: Why does my voice lag sometimes?
faqList.answer: This usually happens due to weak internet or background apps. Switch to Wi-Fi and close unused apps 😅.
